title: Zerodot — an original dot-matrix display family
headline: Every letter is a matrix of light.
lede: A fixed-pitch 5×7 dot-matrix family. Weight changes the dot itself, from pin-prick Thin to fat, slightly squared Black, so dots never merge and counters never close. The zero carries its signature centre dot.
presets: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
sections: Glyphs are 5×7 matrices in sources/dotmatrix.txt, set on a 110-unit pitch in a 6-dot monospaced cell. Every lit position becomes one closed dot contour, so nothing is ever unioned or merged. Weight sets the dot diameter and its squareness. Italics slant the matrix by 10° and keep the dots round, like a slanted physical display.
The dotted zero is the default: O is open, 0 carries the dot. zero swaps in a slashed zero, ss01 a plain one.
Box-drawing lines are dotted on the same pitch, so rules continue seamlessly across cells. Blocks are solid so they tile, and shades are dot fields.
install_html:
mkdir -p ~/.local/share/fonts/Zerodot
unzip Zerodot-v1.000.zip -d ~/.local/share/fonts/Zerodot
fc-cache -f ~/.local/share/fonts
fc-list | grep Zerodot

Web: <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/zerodot.css"> then font-family: "Zerodot";. Nix: nix build github:r3dg0d/zerodot-font.
footer: Zerodot · OFL-1.1 · lit dot by dot
